name: Himekiri Misaki
source:
A pianist and singer who was invited to perform on the Idinaloq.

[spoiler]She was manipulated by [url=https://vndb.org/c124942]Ritsu Kamiji[/url] into attempting to murder [url=https://vndb.org/c102055]Merja Amabishi[/url] through use of an explosive. However, Ritsu secretly delayed the explosion, and Misaki joined [url=https://vndb.org/c102052]Hitomi Akeneno[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c102054]Chisono Shio[/url] in attempting to save Merja's life. Misaki came to regret her attempted murder, and after escaping from the Idinaloq, she turned herself in to the police. About six months later, she was granted a suspended sentence and returned to performing.[/spoiler]
